activation_blockers: No explicit triggering Alert is delivered by the current TOM handler surface.
Kafka partition/offset are hidden by the ANTARES high-level return path and TOM handler surface.
Default automatic commits can advance independently of TROVE durable-ingest completion.
Disabling automatic commit alone gives the current TOM wrapper no durable acknowledgement/progress path.
A handler exception terminates the listener thread; readstreams provides no restart supervisor.

A poison-message policy cannot safely log-and-continue because later commits on the same partition can skip an unresolved failed offset unless failure is durably quarantined or the partition is stopped.

minimum_next_contract.trigger: explicit current ANTARES Alert, not inferred from locus history
minimum_next_contract.transport_identity: stable namespace + topic + partition + offset (+ broker delivery id if available)
minimum_next_contract.ack: only after durable evidence success, or after durable quarantine for a permanent poison message
minimum_next_contract.transient_failure: no acknowledgement; stop/retry without committing past the failed offset
minimum_next_contract.permanent_failure: durably quarantine raw/lossless trigger plus coordinates, then intentionally acknowledge to unblock the partition
minimum_next_contract.consumer_group: stable, explicit group identity across restarts/deployments
